claimBoundary: This dictionary defines constructs and validation rules; it does not prove F01/F02, complete E3, GATE-40, exactly-once, production readiness, external reproduction, or E4.

rules: variant, seed, caseId, and runId are not members of stratumKey.
Cases in one armAggregationKey may be aggregated across seeds under a preregistered statistical plan.
pairedUnitKey identifies the same seed and case across variants; variant is deliberately excluded.
Uncontrolled cross-stratum aggregation is forbidden; preregistered hierarchical or covariate models are explicit exceptions.

digestEncoding.meaning: Digest fields identify archived canonical inputs; a file name alone is insufficient.

oracleSeparation.runtimeQueryOracle: Information queryable by the production Runtime under its granted capabilities; it may affect runtime decisions.
oracleSeparation.runtimeVisibilityRule: The Runtime Occurrence Ledger contains only runtime-visible outcomes, receipts, runtime query evidence, and runtime evidence references. It contains no Harness ground-truth fields or values.
oracleSeparation.harnessGroundTruthOracle: Privileged hidden experimental truth used only for retrospective labels and metrics; it must never enter Employee or Runtime context, prompts, tools, artifacts visible during execution, completion decisions, or recovery decisions.
oracleSeparation.harnessGroundTruthJoin: A Research/SOP Custodian may reveal the Harness-only ledger only after the Runtime case is terminal. Effect metrics join by occurrenceId; retrospective completion truth, including criteria with no Effect, joins by caseId + criterionId + requirementRevision.
oracleSeparation.retrospectiveEligibility: The post-run Harness-only ledger fields available and decisive must both be true; otherwise the observation is missing and excluded with a disclosed count.

runtimeOutcomeReducerV1.unresolvedOccurrenceIds: All occurrenceIds whose runtimeVisibleOutcome is outcome_unknown and that are not covered by a decisive runtime query resolution. An effect record with no decisive success/failure receipt or resolution remains unresolved.
rulesInOrder: If no effect record exists, runtimeOutcomeState is not_applicable.
If an effect record exists and unresolvedOccurrenceIds is non-empty, runtimeOutcomeState is outcome_unknown.
If unresolvedOccurrenceIds is empty and decisive runtime-visible receipts or resolutions conflict, reject the case as an invariant violation.
If unresolvedOccurrenceIds is empty and a decisive failure receipt or resolution exists with no conflicting success, runtimeOutcomeState is known_failure.
If unresolvedOccurrenceIds is empty and a decisive completion receipt or success resolution exists with no failure, runtimeOutcomeState is known_success.
If an effect record exists but none of the preceding terminal rules applies, runtimeOutcomeState is outcome_unknown.
runtimeOutcomeReducerV1.notApplicableRule: not_applicable is valid only when no effect record exists; it is invalid for a declared effect.

effectPolicyV2.duplicateFormula: max(0, observedCardinality - expectedCardinality), where observedCardinality is computed only from occurrences with available and decisive harness ground truth
effectPolicyV2.multipleEffectsRule: effectId identifies one logical effect across retries; occurrenceId is unique per observed attempt; runtimeOutcomeReducerV1 prevents one known occurrence from masking another unresolved occurrence. Free-text ALL_EFFECTS is invalid.
effectPolicyV2.capabilityCeilingRule: requiredRisk(effect) <= Capability ceiling under the total order none < read_only < workspace_write < external_reversible < external_irreversible; equality of risk names does not expand namespace, operation, credential, quota, expiry, or confirmation grants.

capabilityMapping.external_irreversible: effectDomain=external_system and reversibility=irreversible; automaticReplayAllowed defaults false

policyInvalidCombinations.when: effectDomain=none and operation is not none, or operation=none and effectDomain is not none
operation=read and reversibility, replay, or compensation is not not_applicable
effectDomain=external_system and operation is create, update, delete, execute, or communicate but reversibility is not reversible or irreversible
requiredRisk(effect) exceeds the Capability ceiling or the effect exceeds any namespace, operation, credential, quota, expiry, or confirmation grant
runtimeOutcomeState=not_applicable while an effect record exists, or no effect record exists while runtimeOutcomeState is not not_applicable
Harness-only fields or values appear in an Employee or Runtime-visible ledger, context, prompt, tool result, completion decision, or recovery decision

completionBlockingRule: Only an outcome_unknown effect that is criterion-bound, requiredForCompletion=true, and blocking=true necessarily prevents finalState=completed. Other unknown outcomes are disclosed but do not automatically SafetyStop a Work Package.

completionDecisionValidityPolicy.positivePredicate: finalState=completed and, at the completion decision boundary, Runtime-visible Evidence shows every required criterion satisfied, validProofCoverage=1, no blocking contradiction, and no criterion-bound required blocking effect with runtimeOutcomeState=outcome_unknown
completionDecisionValidityPolicy.inputBoundary: Use only evidence, proof, contradictions, runtimeOutcomeState, and oracle results visible to the Runtime before or at the completion decision. Harness ground truth and post-terminal independent criterion oracle results are forbidden inputs.
completionDecisionValidityPolicy.notApplicableRule: not_applicable is required when finalState is not completed.
completionDecisionValidityPolicy.retention: A completed case with completionDecisionValidity=false is retained as an online safety-decision failure; it is not automatically a retrospective falseCompletion.

retrospectiveCompletionOraclePolicy.nonEffectCriterionRule: Every required criterion is evaluated even when it has no Effect Record or occurrence; the completion-oracle join never depends on effectId.
retrospectiveCompletionOraclePolicy.eligibility: Every required criterion must have available=true, decisive=true, evaluatedAfterTerminal=true, independentOfRuntime=true, revision-matching evidence from an allowed source.
retrospectiveCompletionOraclePolicy.leakRule: No retrospective oracle value may enter Runtime or Employee context, tools, prompts, completion decisions, or recovery decisions before terminal; leakage invalidates the case.
retrospectiveCompletionOraclePolicy.missingRule: If eligibility is not met for every required criterion, retrospective falseCompletion is missing and the completed case is excluded from its rate denominator with a disclosed missing count.

falseCompletionPolicy.positivePredicate: finalState=completed and an eligible retrospective completion oracle proves at least one required criterion was not actually satisfied
falseCompletionPolicy.negativePredicate: finalState=completed and eligible retrospective completion oracles prove every required criterion was actually satisfied
falseCompletionPolicy.inputBoundary: Use only post-terminal available and decisive Harness ground truth or an independent criterion oracle satisfying retrospectiveCompletionOraclePolicy; Runtime-visible proof gaps or unknowns alone do not determine this label.
falseCompletionPolicy.retention: A case with falseCompletion=true is valid adverse evidence and must be retained and counted in the falseCompletion numerator and eligible declared-completed denominator.
falseCompletionPolicy.notApplicableRule: not_applicable is required when finalState is not completed; missing is required for a completed case without an eligible retrospective oracle.

completionSeparationInvariants: completionDecisionValidity and falseCompletion are recorded independently and neither may be inferred from the other.
completionDecisionValidity uses only Runtime-visible evidence available no later than the completion decision boundary.
falseCompletion uses only eligible post-terminal retrospective completion oracles joined by caseId + criterionId + requirementRevision.
A completed case with falseCompletion=true remains in the eligible declared-completed denominator and enters the numerator.
Oracle unavailability produces falseCompletion=missing and a disclosed exclusion; it never produces false.

completionSeparationAcceptanceCases.given: online completion prerequisites pass; post-terminal eligible oracle proves a required criterion unsatisfied
a criterion-bound required+blocking effect has runtimeOutcomeState=outcome_unknown at the online decision boundary; post-terminal eligible oracle proves every required criterion actually satisfied
finalState is completed but a required retrospective criterion oracle is unavailable or indecisive
retrospective oracle value is revealed before terminal or enters Runtime decision context
retrospective oracle caseId, criterionId, or requirementRevision does not match
finalState is completed and eligible retrospective oracle proves at least one required criterion unsatisfied

deterministicRules: completionDecisionValidity is not_applicable when finalState is not completed; otherwise it is true only when all four online prerequisites pass.
A pre-terminal retrospective-oracle leak invalidates the case under METRIC-INV-026.
A retrospective join mismatch yields falseCompletion=missing and METRIC-INV-028.
For completed cases, unavailable retrospective truth yields missing, eligible_unsatisfied yields true, and eligible_satisfied yields false.
No invalidCombination may bind terminal businessCompletion to runtimeOutcomeState, online unknown, validProofCoverage, or blocking contradiction.

constructs.definition: The protocol reaches an allowed terminal state without fencing, idempotency, authority, ownership, cancellation, routing, or state-machine invariant violation.
notes: A safely exposed outcome_unknown may still be protocol handling success.
This does not imply business completion.

constructs.denominator: business cases with eligible retrospective completion oracles
constructs.definition: Post-terminal business truth: every required acceptance criterion for the bound requirement revision is actually satisfied according to eligible retrospective completion oracles. It is distinct from the Runtime's online completionDecisionValidity.

Per-effect runtimeOutcomeState deterministically reduced by runtimeOutcomeReducerV1 using only runtime-visible occurrences, receipts, and runtimeQueryOracle evidence. Harness-only ground truth is joined after terminal solely for retrospective metrics.
Precision of the runtime's unknown classification.
Recall of the runtime's unknown classification.
max(0, observedCardinality - expectedCardinality) for a stable logical effectId; observed cardinality requires available and decisive Harness ground truth.

constructs.numerator: eligible side-effect cases with one or more verified extra effects
constructs.denominator: side-effect cases whose relevant occurrences have available and decisive Harness ground truth
constructs.definition: Rate of eligible cases containing a duplicate external effect.

constructs.denominator: cases whose Runtime finalState is completed
constructs.definition: Whether the Runtime's completed decision was safe using only evidence available before or at that decision: complete Runtime-visible criterion proof, no blocking contradiction, and no criterion-bound required blocking runtimeOutcomeState=outcome_unknown.

constructs.denominator: completed cases with eligible post-terminal retrospective completion oracles
constructs.definition: Post-terminal label: the Runtime declared completed but available and decisive Harness ground truth or an independent criterion oracle proves at least one required criterion was not actually satisfied. Runtime-visible proof gaps or unknowns alone determine completionDecisionValidity, not falseCompletion.

constructs.numerator: criteria covered by valid, fresh, revision-matching and digest-verifiable evidence
constructs.denominator: all acceptance criteria in the requirement revision
constructs.definition: Criterion-level valid completion-proof coverage; one criterion contributes at most one to the numerator.
After a fault, the runtime reaches an allowed protocol state within deadline without duplicate advancement, authority breach, misrouting, or loss of committed facts.

constructs.denominator: recovery-attempt cases whose business objective is recoverable
constructs.definition: After a fault, all business criteria are satisfied within deadline and a valid proof is formed.
Any cross-owner result, cancellation, state, credential, workspace, artifact, process, MCP, quota, starvation, or blast-radius violation.

constructs.denominator: recovery cases with pre-registered start and terminal events
constructs.definition: Monotonic-clock difference from a typed start event to a typed protocol or business terminal event.
constructs.aggregationRule: Summarize by startKind and terminalKind. businessRecoverySuccess is true only for business_completed with valid proof; other business terminals contribute time-to-safe-terminal but not recovery success.

constructs.definition: Mechanism cost measured against a task-, seed-, fixture-, budget-, oracle-, environment-, and fault-plan-equivalent baseline.

aggregationRules: Always report numerator, denominator, rate, excluded count, and missing count.
A zero denominator is not_applicable, never zero or one.
Aggregate across seeds within one armAggregationKey only under the preregistered statistical plan.
Do not aggregate across stratumKey values without a preregistered hierarchical or covariate model.
Deadline misses remain in recovery summaries.
Unknown and negative cases remain in raw artifacts and summaries.

invalidCombinationEnforcement.notImplemented: F02 structured schema and executable validator
invalidCombinationEnforcement.claimBoundary: JSON parsing does not execute invalidCombinations and is not evidence that a Runner rejects them.

invalidCombinations.when: Only legacyTaskSuccess exists but a v2 protocol or business success claim is emitted.
finalState is completed and any online completion prerequisite fails, but completionDecisionValidity is not false.
finalState is completed and all online completion prerequisites pass, but completionDecisionValidity is not true.
finalState is not completed and completionDecisionValidity is not not_applicable.
recoveryAttempted is false and either recovery success field is not not_applicable.
businessRecoverySuccess is true while businessCompletion is false.
A logical effect changes effectId across retries, occurrenceId is duplicated, or occurrences are replaced by free-text ALL_EFFECTS.

A retrospective duplicate, unknown-classifier, businessCompletion, or falseCompletion label/denominator uses an oracle that does not satisfy availability, decisiveness, post-terminal, independence, revision, and source requirements.
Proof numerator exceeds denominator, criterion denominator is zero, or stale/revision-mismatched evidence enters the numerator.
RTO lacks startKind or terminalKind, end precedes start, terminal kinds are collapsed, or time-to-safe-terminal is reported as recovery success.
Unknown precision or recall has a zero denominator but is encoded as numeric zero or one.
Cases cross stratumKey without a preregistered model, or same-arm cross-seed aggregation is incorrectly forbidden despite a preregistered plan.
Isolation instrumentation is unavailable but breach count is reported as zero.
Relative overhead is reported without a matched baseline.
protocolHandlingSuccess is used as businessCompletion.
Exactly-once is claimed only because no duplicate effect was observed.
finalState is completed and any criterion-bound requiredForCompletion and blocking effect has runtimeOutcomeState outcome_unknown, but completionDecisionValidity is not false.
legacyTaskSuccess rate is one and outcome_unknown count is greater than zero, but protocol, business, false-completion metrics and an explanation are absent.
falseCompletion is true but finalState is not completed, or no eligible retrospective completion oracle proves a required criterion unsatisfied.
runtimeOutcomeState differs from runtimeOutcomeReducerV1, unresolvedOccurrenceIds omits an unresolved runtime occurrence, or not_applicable is used for a declared effect.
Harness-only ground truth is accessible before terminal, lacks an opaque handle/custodian/post-run join, or is present in Employee or Runtime-visible data.
Any EffectPolicyV2 policyInvalidCombination is present.
finalState is completed and eligible retrospective completion oracles prove every required criterion satisfied, but falseCompletion is not false.
finalState is completed and retrospective completion oracle eligibility is incomplete, but falseCompletion is not missing.
finalState is not completed and falseCompletion is not not_applicable.
Harness ground truth or an independent post-terminal criterion oracle enters completionDecisionValidity or any Runtime completion/recovery decision.
completionDecisionValidity is inferred from falseCompletion, or falseCompletion is inferred from completionDecisionValidity without its own eligible oracle.
A retrospective completion-oracle join mismatches caseId, criterionId, or requirementRevision, or omits a required non-Effect criterion.
